comment: Forms conformance timeline. Every capture is taken at REST, at least 0.3 s after the action that precedes it, so the comparison is of settled layout and not of two animation curves. Same file drives Tools/oracle2/confprobe (real UIKit) and `openhost --app Forms` (the port). t200 is the empty form; t1200 is first-responder + keyboard inset; t2100 is typed text still focused; t3000 switch on; t3900 slider at 0.7; t4800 segment 2; t5700 after blur.
